videos.title: NHS-R Podcast Episode 3 - Friends and Family text mining project
videos.description:
Episode 3 of NHS-R podcast first distributed on Soundcloud   

Chris Beeley talks to Andreas Soteriades about a Friends and Family text mining project. 

Thanks as always to Tom Jemmett for his fantastic editing Links: https://github.com/CDU-data-science-team/pxtextmining https://github.com/CDU-data-science-team/pxtextminingdashboard https://github.com/CDU-data-science-team/experiencesdashboard https://github.com/nhs-r-community/pxtextmineR 

Edited with Clipchamp with auto subtitles which were edited by Zoë Turner

videos.title: NHS-R Podcast Episode 2 - Public Health England COVID dashboard team
videos.description:
Episode 2 of NHS-R podcast first distributed in 2022 on Soundcloud   

Chris Beeley talks to the Covid dashboard team - it was under Public Health England at the time of the podcast - Clare Griffiths, James Westwood, Pouria Hadjibagheri and Anxo Roibas. 

https://ukhsa-dashboard.data.gov.uk/
https://github.com/UKHSA-Internal/coronavirus-dashboard

Edited with Clipchamp with auto subtitles which were edited by Zoë Turner

videos.title: NHS-R Podcast Episode 1 part 2 - the history of NHS-R Community
videos.description:
Episode 1, part 2 of NHS-R podcast first distributed in 2022 on Soundcloud https://soundcloud.com/nhs-r-community/nhs-r-podcast-episode-1

In this first half of episode 1 Professor Mohammed Mohammed featuring Paul Stroner, Sarah Culkin, Jenny Morgan, Ellen Coughlan, and Chris Beeley talk about the history of R, NHS-R Community and its conferences.

Edited with Clipchamp with auto subtitles which were edited by Zoë Turner
